q_A: SELECT count(*) FROM ship WHERE disposition_of_ship = 'Captured'
gold_q_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "ship" AS "ship" WHERE "ship"."vessel_disposition" = 'Captured'

q_A: SELECT name , RESULT , bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name , T1.result , T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location = 'English Channel'
gold_q_B: SELECT "battle"."name" AS "name", "battle"."result" AS "result", "battle"."bulgarian_commander" AS "bulgarian_commander" FROM "battle" AS "battle" EXCEPT SELECT "t1"."name" AS "name", "t1"."result" AS "result", "t1"."bulgarian_commander" AS "bulgarian_commander" FROM "battle" AS "t1" JOIN "ship" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id" = "t2"."lost_in_battle" WHERE "t2"."site" = 'English Channel'
